title: Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing Late Fee Relationship Share
content:
**Customer relationship terms.** A late fee on a Ridgeline Home Improvement Financing account whose plan carries no promotion (a fixed-rate or low-payment plan) is multiplied by the relationship share: a customer whose entry or patio door contract was paid by cash, check or card and is closed takes the door-customer share of 85%; otherwise a customer with an active CareLine service plan takes the CareLine share of 95%; any other customer leaves the figure whole.

A CareLine service plan here means a CareLine Basic, Plus, Premier, Premier 3-Year or Estate plan in active status; an On-Call Service Account is not a CareLine plan. The door contract is read from the customer's Entry & Patio Door Contracts records (its payment method and its status), and the plan from the customer's CareLine Service Plans records.

## Relationship share

| Closed door contract paid by cash, check or card | Active CareLine plan | Late fee multiplied by |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | 85% |
| Yes | No | 85% |
| No | Yes | 95% |
| No | No | 100% (left whole) |

## Points of judgement

- A door contract paid through Ridgeline financing does not meet the first condition, whatever its status.
- A door contract paid by cash, check or card that is not yet closed does not meet the first condition.
- An On-Call Service Account, or a CareLine plan that is past due, cancelled or expired, is not an active CareLine plan.
- The share multiplies the figure before rounding; the late fee is rounded to the cent only as the final figure, to the nearest cent with an exact half cent rounding up.

**Hypothetical illustration.** A late fee figure of 20.00 for a customer with an active CareLine Plus Plan and no door contract: 20.00 times 95% is 19.00.
